headline: President Bush extended the life of a federal task force that studies environmental health and safety risks to children.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 13045, to keep the Task Force on Environmental Health Risks and Safety Risks to Children running longer. The task force brings federal agencies together to look at how things like pollution and safety hazards affect children's health. No summary was provided, so details such as the new end date are not stated here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies on the task force
who_it_affects.how: They continue working together on children's environmental health and safety issues for a longer period.
Federal attention to environmental and safety risks that affect children continues through the task force.
